name: EPIC 201814851
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 8.0 solar radii and 0.92 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201814851 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.031146 (16th-84th percentiles 7.68762-8.404795), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201814851 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.923886 (16th-84th percentiles 0.826785-1.035823), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201814851: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4983.978 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201814851 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3333.4375 (16th-84th percentiles 3220.15625-3452.5), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = -0.01 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,333 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.92 solar masses and 8.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,984 K at its surface.
